latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of aliyun-modelstudio-entry-test.
- Provides a minimal test matrix for all Model Studio skills in the repo, including image, video, audio, speech, multimodal, embedding, rerank, and editing.
- Defines a standard output template for test results.
- Includes prerequisites, failure handling guidance, and workflow for running validation and saving evidence.
